title: Heavy downpours flood Seoul streets, cause damage
caption:
Gale-force gusts and sudden cloudbursts overwhelmed Seoul's storm drainage when seasonal leaf litter choked street grates. Here is how the localized deluge paralyzed major roads despite industrial pumping stations.
